WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from, member_key,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT join_date, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members,
       sum(CASE WHEN version_no=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_versions,
       min(valid_from) AS min_vf, max(valid_from) AS max_vf
FROM fv WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-22' AND DATE '2026-09-28'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT max(join_date) AS max_join, max(valid_from) AS max_vf, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS m, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT max(period_end_date) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fully_loaded) AS loaded_through FROM dim_member

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no,
         COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_join_dates
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT count(*) AS new_members, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_ids, sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online,
       max(n_join_dates) AS max_join_dates, sum(CASE WHEN valid_from<>join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_mismatch
FROM fv WHERE version_no=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
